limitations: URL counters track live Blob handles, not actual process or GPU RAM. Browser controls decoder cache reclamation.
Active scene projections remain pinned, including beneath title overlays; repeated transitions must not accumulate old scenes.
Counter epochs reset on page reload. DOM RGBA estimates can double-count shared sources.
Initial full QPK fetch/parse still materializes compressed and unpacked bytes. Large products need chapter QPK organization; no streaming parser was implemented.
Persistent cache quota must fit mounted content; this is not a RAM limit or automatic safe eviction of mounted bundles.
